svg.text: Knowledge Distillation Objectives Used in the TACO Experiments

text.tspan: Each method starts from the same supervised retrieval objective. The structural difference is which extra
teacher signal is injected into training.
Best read as score-level supervision only.
Good when query geometry matters more than document
Visual summary: ScoreDistill learns ranking scores; EmbedDistill additionally aligns queries; PairDistill sharpens positive-vs-hard-negative preference; BiMGA is the only method
here that aligns both query and document embeddings while weighting by teacher confidence.
